case_title: Anversinh @ Kiransinh Fatesinh Zala v. State of Gujarat
trial_court_outcome: Convicted under ss.363 and 366 of IPC
neutral_facts: The accused, a young man, was involved in an incident where a minor girl, aged 16, was taken from her parents' custody. The girl was working as a maid and was last seen leaving her workplace with the accused. The accused admitted to having sexual intercourse with the girl and intending to marry her. Witnesses testified that the accused induced the girl to accompany him to a designated place. The girl was later found with the accused at a farm near Modasa. The prosecution alleged that the accused had enticed the girl to leave her parents' custody with the intention of marriage and to engage in sexual intercourse. The trial court convicted the accused under sections 363 and 366 of the IPC, while the High Court upheld the conviction but reduced the sentence. The Supreme Court reviewed the case, considering the accused's young age, the nature of the relationship, and the lack of force or pre-planning, and ultimately reduced the sentence to the period already served.
